canonical_authorities.supervisor_handoff: Protected objectives and task board are immutable inputs until one offline materialization. IntentRepository@1/DatabaseTaskSource@1 materializes them into DuckDB. During live execution QuackStateServer@1 is the exclusive typed owner, configured_board_scheduler launches the existing multi-supervisor runner, and that runner invokes the existing implementation supervisor/daemon. Validators produce observations; only admitted current-tree validation and receipt paths can support merge, terminalization, or promotion decisions.
canonical_authorities.state_machine: TypedStateOwnerGateway@1 through the exclusive Quack owner is the sole production mutation authority. DatabaseTaskSource and IntentRepository are its operational facade and transactional substrate. Direct multi-process DuckDB opens, raw SQL authority enlargement, stale leases/fences, and automatic file fallback are forbidden.
canonical_authorities.routing: ipfs_accelerate_py owns executor selection and provider/model routing. The canonical future route is the requirements-ordered deterministic-first ladder; the scheduler's capacity projection and a provider's availability are observations, never independent dispatch authority.
canonical_authorities.context_pack: ipfs_datasets_py alone owns semantic identity, canonical IR/schema meaning, minimal ContextPack construction, obligations, lineage, and proof relationships. ipfs_kit_py owns canonical bytes, CIDs, immutable blocks, current-root CAS, WAL, recovery, retention, and optional replication. ipfs_accelerate_py owns freshness checks, selection, executor choice, and proof/test reuse admission for the current tree; durable storage does not prove semantic correctness or reuse admission.
canonical_authorities.ducklake: DuckLake is a non-authoritative, append-only, rebuildable analytics/history projection only. It cannot authorize claims, readiness, leases, completion, promotion, recovery, or terminalization.

nonclaims: This inventory does not claim the source tree is production-qualified, promotion-authorized, live-measured, or complete.
A process liveness signal, Markdown status, raw test exit status, stored proof bytes, and DuckLake projection are observations, not completion or promotion authority.
No compatibility adapter, fallback, fixture, or capability probe may claim authority independently.
